skrow.description: A blockchain-based guarantor-service. Securing customer interactions with non-trusted sellers. Most online courses out there are designed by marketers who don't truly understand the technical side. I’ve even joined a few to experience them firsthand and got really disappointed. These days, there are too many sales-driven courses that has in fact no real value behind them.That's why I believe the best way to achieve meaningful results is through
